CustomField.description: FB-798 spec (Ramp MRC and TCV Calculation Spec): sum of OrderItem.Order_MRC__c across this Order's lines — the incremental MRC this ramp order contributes, not the running/cumulative total. Computed by OrderMrcRollupService at ramp order creation. Used for commissions, bookings, and revenue recognition reporting — distinct from Total_MRC__c, which is this order's own face-value monthly charge.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Incremental MRC this ramp order adds (sum of line-level deltas), not the running total. Auto-calculated - do not edit manually.
CustomField.label: Total Order MRC (Delta)
